problems.quote: By angles, a triangle may be acute (all angles 90°).
problems.problem: An acute triangle has all angles less than 90°, not equal to 90°. A triangle with all angles 90° is impossible (sum would be 270°).
problems.correction: By angles, a triangle may be acute (all angles < 90°).
problems.verifierReason: Original wrong: acute triangle has angles <90°, not 90°. Correction accurate.

problems.quote: The area between the two curves represents the inter‑quartile range.
problems.problem: The interquartile range (IQR) is the difference between the third and first quartiles (Q3−Q1), a horizontal distance on the x‑axis, not the area between the two ogive curves.
problems.correction: The inter‑quartile range is the horizontal distance between Q1 and Q3.
problems.verifierReason: IQR is Q3-Q1, a horizontal distance; area between curves is incorrect.

problems.quote: the curve passes through the midpoint of each class interval
problems.problem: An ogive (cumulative frequency curve) passes through the upper class boundaries (for a less‑than ogive) or lower class boundaries (for a more‑than ogive), not the midpoints. Midpoints are used for frequency polygons.
problems.correction: the curve passes through the upper class boundaries (less‑than ogive)
problems.verifierReason: Ogive uses class boundaries, not midpoints; correction correctly states upper boundaries for less-than ogive.

problems.quote: the slant height is derived from the difference of half‑diagonals
problems.problem: Slant height of a square pyramid frustum is derived from difference of half-side lengths (apothems), not half-diagonals.
problems.correction: the slant height is derived from the difference of half‑side lengths
problems.verifierReason: Slant height of square pyramid frustum uses half-side lengths (apothems), not half-diagonals. Correction accurate.

problems.quote: using the outer radius in the formula 2πR h t overestimates the volume by a factor of (R/r)
problems.problem: The overestimation factor is 2R/(R+r), not R/r.
problems.correction: using the outer radius in the formula 2πR h t overestimates the volume by a factor of 2R/(R+r)
problems.verifierReason: Volume of cylindrical shell: exact πh(R²−r²); outer radius approx 2πRht gives factor 2R/(R+r), not R/r. Correction correct.
